What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap at 7.246, 0.754 under the 8.0 top rung.
    Round 1 carried one hard fail (the cover's unattributed 'watcher' framing), repaired before round 2.
  • The art median is 6.8, under the 8.5 craft floor, which stands down at the cap.
    The judges still charge frame 8's generic dais, frames 2 and 5 as flat plan reliefs where the argument turns, and frame 6 repeating frame 1's camera.
  • Frame 9's hook reads '133 cents' rather than '$1.33' because numeral_trace and aggregate_check accept a computed figure only in phrasings their detector reads (queued October 29th).
  • The planned needle macro on frame 6 failed twice and the earlier camera was kept.
  • record_done was missed at Phase 8 and stamped late, so the clock's record phase reads long.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Weighed in one motion, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

$390,000 is not what ChatGPT costs Plano.

It is the ceiling on one item from the October 12th City Council agenda. ChatGPT Enterprise is $190,000 of it. Darwin AI is $150,000. Its maker says the platform tracks AI use across users, tools and departments. Microsoft Enterprise adds $10,000. The last $40,000 is held for growth.

For every chatbot dollar the item sets aside 79 cents for Darwin.

The item sat on the consent agenda, which the council acts on in one motion. The minutes note it approved. The October 26th minutes mark those minutes approved, and both sets are still marked draft. Plano's Legistar lists the council's next meeting for November 9th.

The deck weighs the item on a brass balance, one weight per $10,000.

Which city work will ChatGPT Enterprise and Darwin AI be used for?

#Plano #CollinCounty #DentonCounty

The machine changed itself

  • Kit: power_transformer, a substation transformer built for close shots, answering the clay tank, slab fins and floating bushings charged on nos.
    60 and 62. Proof rendered, read at full size, 132 of 132 kit sizes true.
  • Gate: deck_chassis now refuses a flat frame whose scrim and veil run before the 2x transform, the cause of today's relief band.
    Red on today's drafts, clean on every shipped deck.
  • Gate: the three-frame audition now checks layout_check's detail floor before the art director reviews it.
    Three straight decks met that floor late.
  • Doctrine: TECHNIQUE_LIBRARY gains a material relief entry with five measured failures and the fix that cleared each.
  • Needs a maintainer: a GATE_LESSONS entry for the new deck_chassis rule (human lane).
    The run lane can fix fetch_doc's robots reader, which ignores a ClaudeBot group, and prompt_audit's count of dispatch latency as waits.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

THE RECORD. Thirty items re-verified on the two day leash. tx-2026-0195 follows its moved Texas Children's release. Four UNT and UTA items now carry measured robots boundaries. Admitted tx-2026-0234, Plano's City Council consent item of October 12th for ChatGPT Enterprise ($190,000), the Darwin AI platform ($150,000), Microsoft Enterprise ($10,000) and a $40,000 reserve inside a $390,000 ceiling, on the city's own Legistar records. Its title was corrected the same day. It had said the platform monitors how city staff use AI, which no source states. THE DECK. Carousel no. 63 weighs the item on one brass balance at one slotted weight per $10,000, a drawing unit. Two pixel rounds, one flow pass, three panel rounds. Round 1 filed a hard fail on the cover's unattributed "watcher" framing. The repair attributes Darwin's function to its maker and its reseller, ties the reseller's page to the maker's site, and found that the October 26th meeting's draft minutes mark the October 12th minutes approved. The close names the council's next meeting on Plano's Legistar, November 9th. Round 3 at the cap: 7.246, so the deck ships under the 8.0 bar with the shortfall named. FOUND AND FIXED. The dark band on the two relief frames was this deck's own bug, a post pass drawn before the 2x transform. The weekly pass turned it into a deck_chassis rule. PERMISSIONS. prompt_audit read 2,017 tool calls and reported 299 as waiting on a human, led by Agent dispatches of 20 to 25 seconds. The no-stall hook was armed at 05:03:37 UTC, judged the session unattended from its first call with the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0, and refused nothing. The waits read as dispatch latency rather than dialogs, which is the queued prompt-audit-counts-agent-latency item. THE WEEKLY MACHINE PASS ran today (the detail floor defect had reached repeat 2). Four changes, each verified again by the run, listed under the machine heading.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
